title: Fake DRULPA section
text: The general partner may rely on financial statements under 6 Del. C. § 17-170.

should_error.reason: § 17-170 does not exist in the Delaware Code.

title: Fake will execution section
text: A last will and testament shall be executed in compliance with 12 Del. C. § 2999.

title: Fake directed trust section
text: The directed trustee shall follow the investment direction of the trust adviser under 12 Del. C. § 1331.

title: Fake power of attorney section
text: The agent under a durable personal power of attorney may make gifts under 12 Del. C. § 49A-999.

title: Fake health-care section
text: An advance health-care directive shall comply with 16 Del. C. § 31999.

title: Fake decedents estates section
text: The personal representative shall administer the estate under 12 Del. C. § 1199.

title: Computer crime single section trap
text: Any unauthorized access to a computer system shall constitute a crime under 11 Del. C. § 932.

title: Good Samaritan / emergency immunity detection
text: A physician who renders emergency care at the scene of an accident shall be immune from civil liability for any act or omission in rendering such care under Delaware law.

should_warn.reason: Good Samaritan / emergency immunity topic should trigger review with relevant sections.
